LEFT JOIN js_sys_office backup_o ON a.company = backup_o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive backup_p ON a.department = backup_p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON a.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line backup_fpl ON a.prod_line = backup_fpl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' AND ( p.id = #{departmentCondition} OR wg.id = #{departmentCondition} OR fpl.id = #{departmentCondition} OR o.office_code = #{departmentCondition} OR a.identity_card = #{departmentCondition} OR a.company = #{departmentCondition} OR a.department = #{departmentCondition} OR a.prod_line = #{departmentCondition} OR a.team = #{departmentCondition} OR a.job_type = #{departmentCondition} ) AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
